<!-- REBASE-48K-20261102:BEGIN -->
## Current rebase and CI status (2026-11-02)

Head `d973ced62c7836931590756af8a9e3e7f6357fc2` is rebased onto upstream main `23c6442cde7fb38230134ba0e3513ad2332aa5cf`. The patch is unchanged according to `git range-diff`.

Local validation: Scoped pre-commit and CPU launch-selection assertions passed; 7 GPU tests skipped; unchanged patch, inherited main #47300 device-alias fix. No fresh GPU/model or performance result is claimed; earlier measurements below remain tied to their original revisions.

[Latest Base run](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/41402860632) (attempt 2) stops at **Require run-ci label (optional)**. The PR is Ready. A CI-authorized maintainer must add `run-ci` and issue `/tag-and-rerun-ci`; the author-requested retry ran but cannot grant the label.

[Repository-wide lint](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/41402860388/job/125138284937) independently fails on `F821 logger` in the unchanged main XPU graph runner. [Upstream report and reproducer](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/30980#issuecomment-6571123990). The PR-scoped local hooks passed; the full upstream check has not passed. Rebase after the main repair lands.

[Rebase validation and CI request](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/47276#issuecomment-6571075867).
<!-- REBASE-48K-20261102:END -->

## Motivation

On gfx950, GLM-5.2 decode and MTP verify with 48 rows or fewer go through the four-kernel fused DSA indexer (#38583). Two of its kernels can do less work:

- **Logits.** With MTP, each request contributes 6 verify rows. All 6 read the same KV pages, but `logits_hist_m` loads every page once per row.
- **Top-k.** `topk_transform` runs 64 blocks per row. Fewer blocks per row lets the grid stay co-resident for its persistent-rank form.

The whole fused-indexer call (4 kernels) gets 1.20x to 1.36x faster, depending on the context mix. End to end at 120k context, median ITL improves 1.8%. Logits are bit-identical and the selected top-k sets are unchanged.

## Modifications

**`paged_mqa_logits.cuh`** now ships three logits kernels. `PagedMqaLogitsKernel::run` takes a new `variant` argument that picks one.

| variant | kernel | used for |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | `logits_hist_m` (unchanged from main) | per-row; 25+ rows that are not 6-row MTP groups |
| 1 | `logits_hist_s` (new, per-row) | 24 rows or fewer |
| 2 | `logits_hist_grp<16, 12, 6>` (new) | 30 to 48 rows that come 6 per request |

- `logits_hist_s` is tuned for short batches:
  - page ids are preloaded one per lane;
  - each page is addressed through a buffer resource;
  - the fine-histogram flush starts at the lowest bin that node 4 can read;
  - when the grid needs more than one round of resident blocks, the longest rows are dispatched first.
- `logits_hist_grp` loads each K page shared by a request's 6 consecutive rows once per group, then scores it for every row of the group.
  - The page loads are shared only after the kernel checks on the device that the siblings' page ids really match. A group whose page ids differ takes the general path, so the result is exact for any input.
  - The per-page math is `logits_hist_m`'s, so the logits are bit-identical.

**`topk_transform.cuh`**: `prank_fit_g` shrinks G to the largest value at or below the requested one that lets the persistent-rank form run, but no lower than 32. G only repartitions an exact selection, so the top-k set does not change. `TOPK_G` goes from 64 to 48.

**Host side.**
- `loader.logits_launch(rows, table_pages, rows_per_request)` returns `(blocks_per_row, variant)`.
- `_gfx950_fused_decode` passes `rows_per_request` as rows divided by batch size on TARGET_VERIFY, and 1 otherwise.
- Shapes are host constants, so every choice is CUDA-graph safe.
- Decode without MTP, other MTP draft counts, and rows that are not a multiple of 6 keep `logits_hist_m` at 25 rows and above.

**Tests** (`test/registered/amd/test_dsa_gfx950_fused_indexer.py`):
- the three variants give bit-identical logits and the same node-4 selection:
  - on 5- and 8-request verify batches from 4k to 300k tokens, with mixed lengths;
  - on grouped rows whose page tables differ;
- the `logits_launch` selection boundaries.

## Accuracy Tests

The logits are bit-identical to main's and the selection is unchanged, as covered by the unit tests above. Beyond those:
- **Whole call against main.** Main's four kernels and this PR's were run on the same inputs, for every case in the tables below plus graph-wide page tables. Every row's top-2048 slot set and every byte of the K written that step are identical.
- **gsm8k (eager).** GLM-5.2-MXFP4, TP8, MTP with acceptance not simulated, 400 questions: main 0.953, this PR (an earlier revision with the same kernels) 0.963. These prompts are short, so this mainly shows nothing else broke.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

**Whole fused-indexer call, kernel level.** Measured on MI355X:
- inputs: 6 rows per request; each request's rows have lengths L+1..L+6; page table 16386 pages wide;
- one CUDA graph runs the call over 4 KV pools, and each sample is that replay divided by 4;
- medians in us.

| rows (requests) | contexts | main | this PR | speedup |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 12 (2) | lognormal, median 180k, max 600k | 52.0 | 44.2 | 1.18x |
| 24 (4) | same | 88.0 | 72.5 | 1.21x |
| 36 (6) | same | 132.5 | 90.6 | 1.46x |
| 48 (8) | same | 167.4 | 114.3 | 1.46x |
| 12 / 24 / 30 / 36 / 42 / 48 | all 120k | 44.3 / 68.5 / 76.7 / 95.1 / 103.7 / 114.2 | 39.6 / 68.9 / 74.5 / 73.9 / 79.9 / 82.9 | 1.12 / 0.99 / 1.03 / 1.29 / 1.30 / 1.38x |

Weighted over a decode rank's batch distribution, the lognormal mix goes from 104.6 to 77.2 us (1.36x). Equal weights at 120k go from 83.3 to 69.7 us (1.20x).

**Logits kernel alone, and why three variants.** 6 rows per request, 120k tokens, us:

| rows | `logits_hist_m` | `logits_hist_s` | `logits_hist_grp` |
|---|---|---|---|
| 12 | 26.3 | **21.5** | 43.6 |
| 24 | 47.2 | **39.8** | 55.2 |
| 30 | 55.2 | 58.6 | **51.0** |
| 36 | 65.8 | 80.9 | **53.5** |
| 48 | 79.1 | 129.5 | **61.2** |

At 400k tokens and 24 rows, the grouped kernel wins (79.9 us against 120.4 for `logits_hist_m`). Below 30 rows the host still picks `logits_hist_s`, because shapes must be fixed at capture time and only short contexts make the grouped kernel lose.

**End to end.**
- Setup: GLM-5.2-MXFP4, TP8, MTP (EAGLE, 5 steps, 6 draft tokens), simulated acceptance 3.61, `--max-running-requests 8`.
- Benchmark: `bench_serving`, random 120k input / 1k output, concurrency 8, 16 prompts per run, 2 runs per server.
- Main and this PR alternate on one node, each in a fresh server.

| | median ITL ms |
|---|---|
| main (4 servers, 8 runs) | 5.06 - 5.10 |
| this PR (2 servers, 4 runs) | 4.96 - 5.00 |

**In-server kernels.** A torch-profiler capture of eager decode at 48 rows came from an earlier revision. In it, `topk_transform` runs 21 us against main's 32 us.

## Relation to #45307

#45307 shares KV pages across MTP verify rows for 18 rows or fewer and contexts of 96k and up. This PR covers 30 to 48 rows, plus `logits_hist_s` and the top-k change. Both PRs add a kernel to `paged_mqa_logits.cuh` and an argument to `PagedMqaLogitsKernel::run`, so they will conflict textually. I am happy to rebase onto whichever lands first.

## How to reproduce

Hardware: MI355X (gfx950), ROCm 7.2. Image: `lmsysorg/sglang-rocm:v0.5.22-rocm720-mi35x-20261018`, whose four `dsa_gfx950/*.cuh` files and `hip_gfx950/loader.py` are byte-identical to main's. For the PR arm, this branch's files are copied over.

```bash
python3 test/registered/amd/test_dsa_gfx950_fused_indexer.py -v      # one gfx950 GPU
SGLANG_OPT_USE_TOPK_V2=true SGLANG_SIMULATE_ACC_LEN=3.61 SGLANG_SIMULATE_ACC_METHOD=match-expected \
SGLANG_SIMULATE_ACC_TOKEN_MODE=real-draft-token python3 -m sglang.launch_server --model-path amd/GLM-5.2-MXFP4 \
  --trust-remote-code --kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3 --dsa-prefill-backend triton --dsa-decode-backend triton \
  --mem-fraction-static 0.85 --speculative-algorithm EAGLE --speculative-num-steps 5 --speculative-eagle-topk 1 \
  --speculative-num-draft-tokens 6 --tensor-parallel-size 8 --max-running-requests 8 --cuda-graph-max-bs-decode 8
python3 -m sglang.bench_serving --backend sglang --dataset-name random --random-input-len 120000 \
  --random-output-len 1000 --random-range-ratio 1.0 --num-prompts 16 --max-concurrency 8 --seed 1
```

The kernel changes were found with an automated kernel-optimization search. This PR ports them onto main, restricts each kernel to the shapes where it measured faster, and adds the selection and tests.

+#   1 logits_hist_s    per row, tuned for short batches (rows <= LOGITS_SHORT_MAX_ROWS);
+#   2 logits_hist_grp  sibling groups: consecutive rows of one request -- the MTP verify rows -- share its page
+#                      table, so each K page is loaded once per group instead of once per row.  The group size is a
+#                      template argument of the kernel (HOST_GR in paged_mqa_logits.cuh).
+# All three produce bit-identical logits and the same top-k selection.
 LOGITS_BLOCKS_PER_ROW = 48
-TOPK_G = 64
+LOGITS_SHORT_BLOCKS_PER_ROW = 32
+# Measured, graph timed, 6 rows per request at 120k tokens: rows 12 / 24 run 22 / 40 us on logits_hist_s against
+# 26 / 48 us on logits_hist_m; from 36 rows logits_hist_s is the slower one (80 vs 66 us).
+LOGITS_SHORT_MAX_ROWS = 24
+LOGITS_GROUP_ROWS = 6
+# Smallest row count routed to the sibling-group kernel (measured at 120k tokens: 30 / 36 / 48 rows run
+# 51 / 54 / 61 us grouped against 55 / 66 / 79 us on logits_hist_m; at 24 rows grouping only wins on long contexts).
+LOGITS_GROUP_MIN_ROWS = 30
+# topk_transform blocks per row.  The row-barrier and cursor-atomic cost per
+# block outweighs the extra fill past ~48 (measured: 48 beats 64 on every case);
+# G only repartitions the exact selection, so the top-k set does not change.
+# The kernel lowers it further where rows * G blocks would not be co-resident
+# for its persistent-rank form.
+TOPK_G = 48
+
+
+def logits_launch(
+    rows: int, table_pages: int, rows_per_request: int
+) -> Tuple[int, int]:
+    """(blocks_per_row, variant) for the logits kernel, in its argument order.
+
+    The sibling-group kernel is used when the rows come ``LOGITS_GROUP_ROWS`` per
+    request and there are at least ``LOGITS_GROUP_MIN_ROWS`` of them; it checks on
+    the device that the siblings really share their page ids and stays exact if
+    they do not.  ``logits_hist_s`` gets ``LOGITS_SHORT_BLOCKS_PER_ROW`` blocks,
+    raised so that a wave never walks more than 64 pages (its page ids live one
+    per lane) and kept a multiple of 8 so block x of every row lands on XCD x % 8.
+    """
+    if (
+        rows_per_request == LOGITS_GROUP_ROWS
+        and rows % LOGITS_GROUP_ROWS == 0
+        and rows >= LOGITS_GROUP_MIN_ROWS
+    ):
+        return 0, 2
+    if rows <= LOGITS_SHORT_MAX_ROWS:
+        need = -(-table_pages // (8 * 64))
+        return max(LOGITS_SHORT_BLOCKS_PER_ROW, -(-need // 8) * 8), 1
+    return LOGITS_BLOCKS_PER_ROW, 0

+    # -- node 3, sibling-group kernel ----------------------------------------
+    def _verify_rows(self, ctxs, pt_width, share=True):
+        """MTP verify rows: LOGITS_GROUP_ROWS rows per request, consecutive, with
+        lengths ctx-5..ctx and (when ``share``) one page table per request, as
+        _gfx950_fused_decode broadcasts it."""
+        g = self.loader.LOGITS_GROUP_ROWS
+        rows = g * len(ctxs)
+        gen = torch.Generator(device=self.dev).manual_seed(1234 + rows)
+        max_pages = max(-(-c // PAGE_SIZE) for c in ctxs)
+        total_pages = max_pages * rows
+        kv = torch.randn(
+            total_pages, PAGE_SIZE * 132, generator=gen, device=self.dev
+        ).to(FP8)
+        perm = torch.randperm(total_pages, generator=gen, device=self.dev).int()
+        page_table_64 = torch.zeros(rows, pt_width, dtype=torch.int32, device=self.dev)
+        seqlens = torch.empty(rows, dtype=torch.int32, device=self.dev)
+        for i, c in enumerate(ctxs):
+            n = -(-c // PAGE_SIZE)
+            for j in range(g):
+                r = i * g + j
+                src = i * max_pages if share else r * max_pages
+                page_table_64[r, :n] = perm[src : src + n]
+                seqlens[r] = c - (g - 1) + j
+        q_fp8 = torch.randn(rows, N_HEADS, HEAD_DIM, generator=gen, device=self.dev).to(
+            FP8
+        )
+        gate = torch.rand(rows, N_HEADS, generator=gen, device=self.dev)
+        return q_fp8, kv, gate, seqlens, page_table_64
+
+    def _logits(self, inputs, cols, variant, blocks_per_row):
+        q_fp8, kv, gate, seqlens, page_table_64 = inputs
+        rows = q_fp8.shape[0]
+        logits = torch.zeros(rows, cols, dtype=torch.float32, device=self.dev)
+        ghist = torch.zeros(
+            rows, self.topk_mod.hist_stride(), dtype=torch.int32, device=self.dev
+        )
+        self.logits_mod.logits_hist(
+            q_fp8,
+            kv,
+            gate,
+            seqlens,
+            page_table_64,
+            logits,
+            ghist,
+            blocks_per_row,
+            variant,
+        )
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()

+
+    def _select(self, logits, ghist, seqlens, page_table_64):
+        rows, cols = logits.shape
+        cap = max(TOPK, cols)
+        out = torch.empty(rows, TOPK, dtype=torch.int32, device=self.dev)
+        self.topk_mod.topk_transform(
+            logits,
+            seqlens,
+            page_table_64,
+            out,
+            ghist,
+            torch.zeros(rows, 32, dtype=torch.int32, device=self.dev),
+            torch.empty(rows, cap, dtype=torch.int32, device=self.dev),
+            torch.empty(rows, cap, dtype=torch.float32, device=self.dev),
+            self.loader.TOPK_G,
+            PAGE_SIZE,
+        )
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+        return [set(r) - {-1} for r in out.tolist()]
+
+    def _assert_variants_agree(self, ctxs, pt_width, share=True):
+        """All three logits kernels: bit-identical logits on every row's valid
+        columns, and the same node-4 selection from each one's histogram (which
+        may differ below the bins node 4 reads, see the gated flush)."""
+        inputs = self._verify_rows(ctxs, pt_width, share=share)
+        seqlens, page_table_64 = inputs[3], inputs[4]
+        rows = seqlens.shape[0]
+        cols = pt_width * PAGE_SIZE
+        _, variant = self.loader.logits_launch(
+            rows, pt_width, self.loader.LOGITS_GROUP_ROWS
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(variant, 2, "expected the sibling-group kernel")
+        short_bpr = max(
+            self.loader.LOGITS_SHORT_BLOCKS_PER_ROW,
+            -(-pt_width // (8 * 64 * 8)) * 8,
+        )
+        runs = {
+            "m": self._logits(inputs, cols, 0, self.loader.LOGITS_BLOCKS_PER_ROW),
+            "s": self._logits(inputs, cols, 1, short_bpr),
+            "grp": self._logits(inputs, cols, 2, 0),
+        }
+        # topk_transform zeroes the histogram it reads, so select once per run.
+        ref_l = runs["m"][0]
+        selections = {
+            name: self._select(lg, hg, seqlens, page_table_64)
+            for name, (lg, hg) in runs.items()
+        }
+        for name, (lg, _) in runs.items():
+            for r in range(rows):
+                n = int(seqlens[r])
+                self.assertTrue(
+                    torch.equal(lg[r, :n], ref_l[r, :n]),
+                    f"{name} row {r}: logits differ from logits_hist_m",
+                )
+            self.assertEqual(selections[name], selections["m"], name)
+
+    def test_group_logits_match_per_row(self):
+        g = self.loader.LOGITS_GROUP_ROWS
+        n_req = -(-self.loader.LOGITS_GROUP_MIN_ROWS // g)
+        for ctxs in (
+            [65536] * n_req,
+            [131072 - 4096 * i for i in range(n_req)],
+            [4096, 200000] + [70000] * (n_req - 2),
+            [300000] * (48 // g),
+        ):
+            with self.subTest(ctxs=ctxs):
+                self._assert_variants_agree(ctxs, pt_width=8192)
+
+    def test_group_logits_unshared_tables_stay_exact(self):
+        """Rows grouped by position whose page tables differ take the kernel's
+        general path; the result must still match the per-row kernel."""
+        n_req = -(-self.loader.LOGITS_GROUP_MIN_ROWS // self.loader.LOGITS_GROUP_ROWS)
+        self._assert_variants_agree([32768] * n_req, pt_width=1024, share=False)
+
+    def test_logits_launch_selection(self):

+        L = self.loader
+        g, lo = L.LOGITS_GROUP_ROWS, L.LOGITS_GROUP_MIN_ROWS
+        self.assertEqual(launch(48, 16386, g), (0, 2))

+        self.assertEqual(launch(48, 16386, 1), (L.LOGITS_BLOCKS_PER_ROW, 0))
+        self.assertEqual(launch(48, 16386, 4), (L.LOGITS_BLOCKS_PER_ROW, 0))
+        self.assertNotEqual(launch(lo - g, 16386, g)[1], 2)
+        for rows, pages in ((8, 16386), (12, 128), (24, 40000)):

+            self.assertEqual(variant, 1)
+            self.assertEqual(b % 8, 0)
+            self.assertLessEqual(-(-pages // (b * 8)), 64)
